test_title: PYST 13: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the son of B',

A - B means 'A is the wife of B',

A × B means 'A is the brother of B',

A ÷ B means 'A is the mother of B'.

Based on the above, if 'P - Q × R + S ÷ T', which of the following is true?

options.text: Q is the son of S.
S is the mother of P.
P is the daughter of T.
T is the son of S.

solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0492f08f0700b7071bb92aa4431f07008cebf61c99c4c2374f8b11e5b890d20.png] 

As per the given information:

 
 

 
 
A is

Son

of B

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

**Given expression:** 'P - Q × R + S ÷ T'

P is the wife of Q, Q is the brother of R, R is the son of S and S is the mother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/947abf7d97b61bff6c9fdb80eaf2de3a63e3b076b7c79c3ba4506798bda4025e.png] 

Checking the given options:

**(1) Q is the son of S → True**

(2) S is the mother of P → False

(3) P is the daughter of T → False

(4) T is the son of S → False

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
